immutable_failure_reproduction.root_cause: The source-ingestion runtime (_connector_freshness_summary_from_snapshot), controller terminal readback validation (_validate_terminal_readback), and BFF surface projector (_freshness_metadata) computed staleness as age_seconds > 86400 without Taiwan market-session awareness. When one-shot bounded refresh ran on the weekend for tw-twse-tpex-official-market, the official Friday close (age ~150,000s) was marked stale, causing freshness_not_accepted and source_data_stale rejection before root compose admission could evaluate the healthy scheduler terminal result.

fail_closed_boundaries: Stale weekday data without valid holiday evidence is rejected as market_input_stale / source_data_stale.
Missing, unparsable, or stale refresh receipt older than 24h is rejected as market_input_stale_refresh / source_data_stale.
Missing or tampered calendar evidence during exchange closure is rejected as market_input_calendar_unverifiable / source_data_stale.
Non-official lineage (source_id not starting with tw-official:) is rejected as market_input_non_official_lineage / source_data_stale.
Future event_time or observed_at is rejected as market_input_invalid / source_data_stale.
Readiness or refresh failure compensates to exact accepted read-only FE/BFF baseline with all writes false.
